title: Verify FareConfirm-based Family-A flow #1 (SR-FC-BK-RT) completes with the expected end-state
request_summary: 4-hop V1 chain, TravelportNdc/UAE, CAI->JED 2026-09-15, 1 ADT + 1 CHD + 1 INF
response_summary: Search 200 (67 offers) / FareConfirm 200 (2290 AED) / Book 409 NDC-INT-TEC-A0002 / Retrieve not executed
expected: Retrieve shows bookingStatus=booked; selectedOffer.offerId and priceDetails.totalAmount match between Book and the follow-up Retrieve; price reconciliation holds at Search, FareConfirm and Book
actual: Flow did not reach its end-state: Book was rejected with HTTP 409 because the supplier (Travelport/QR) exhausted its infant seat quota for this specific flight/date after already allocating an internal hold (GDS PNR HMZQ50). No pnr/bookingToken was returned, so Retrieve could not run.
evidence: Book response: {Status:409, ErrorCode:'NDC-INT-TEC-A0002', ErrorMessage:'A technical error occurred in NDC integration.', Context:[{Name:'TERMINAL', Value:"Booking is still in the hold stage. No ticket has been issued yet. PNR: N/A. GDS PNR: HMZQ50., INFANT QUOTA FOR FLIGHT HAS BEEN EXCEEDED. REBOOK WITH ALTERNATE FLIGHT (AIRLINE QR)"}]}. Response body also contained a raw OriginalSupplierResponse field — redacted from this report per the skill's hard safety rule (SPEC.md §7.14 pattern).

summary: Book can reject with HTTP 409 ErrorCode=NDC-INT-TEC-A0002 after the supplier has already allocated an internal hold (GDS PNR), when a per-passenger-type inventory quota (observed: infant) is exhausted on that specific flight/date
evidence: Confirms the previously-documented-but-unconfirmed race class at §2.9 Common Errors ('inventory sold out between FareConfirm/AddPassenger and Book') with a concrete, evidenced error shape: Context.Value = 'Booking is still in the hold stage. No ticket has been issued yet. PNR: N/A. GDS PNR: HMZQ50., INFANT QUOTA FOR FLIGHT HAS BEEN EXCEEDED. REBOOK WITH ALTERNATE FLIGHT (AIRLINE QR)'.

summary: Book's error response body includes a raw, verbatim OriginalSupplierResponse blob (full supplier XML/JSON) even though Book has no isdebug field at all — the credential/internal-detail exposure risk documented at §7.14/§1476 for Search's isdebug=true is not gated by any flag on Book's failure path
expected_value: Error envelope should contain only Status/TransactionId/ErrorCode/ErrorMessage/Context - no raw supplier request/response passthrough
impact: Any caller who triggers a Book-side supplier rejection (e.g. a quota/availability race, which per this same run is a realistic, now-confirmed occurrence) receives the full raw upstream supplier response unconditionally, extending the previously Search-isdebug-scoped disclosure risk to an unauthenticated-by-flag, always-on path on a mutating endpoint
evidence: Observed directly in this run's Book 409 response body; not printed/saved in this report per the skill's redaction rule.
